## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8735dfe10fef4a124c1226588462b1761798b32e`
Local-runs: none
Scope: ui/docs/adr/0057-console-ai-chat-one-conversation-docked.md + none

Read for this record: card #37819 (body and all 5 comments), PR #37825 (body, file list, its 2 comments, the net diff against `main`, 1 file, +72 / -0), the check-runs on the head, and, to judge the text, objectstack#37788 and objectstack#37787 (bodies) and the live tree on `origin/main` at `9b50fedb`, which contains #37798's squash `8fbae19a`. Code outside the diff was read, not reviewed.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-sets: none change. The diff is prose in one ADR file; no schema, no validator, no gate, no generated artifact. Right.
- Public surface: none. `ui/docs/adr/**` ships in no package (`ui/package.json` is `private: true`). Right.
- Governed surface: `ui/docs/adr/**` is the rules face, so this record and the Tier H hand-off are owed. The PR is a draft and says the area does not land it. Right.
- Gate verdicts, read off the check-runs on this head: 30 success, 17 skipped, 0 failed (`Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `PR-body guards`, `Check PR Size`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Test UI (1/16)` all success). Nothing was re-run here.
- Merge state: `main` moved from the merge base `ff9ee210` to `9b50fedb`; no commit in between touches `ui/docs/adr/`, so the net diff is unchanged by the move.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: nothing in the diff publishes. `Check Changeset` reads skipped / success on the head. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body is right: no accept-set, no declared capability and no public export changes. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Round-1 `open_questions` entry (should the header's **Amended** block name A4): answered by the area (option B) and implemented in round 2 as three header lines. Right call: without it the header still says A3 made the drawer the ONLY chat container, against the body. It is one step past the card's "No other section changes"; it carries no ruling content and follows A3's own precedent. Accepted.
- Round-2 `open_questions`: empty.
- Dev deviations (branch name, PR footer form, the model-named trailer on `ef6a0059`, `pnpm install` in the worktree, the PR body left for the seat): none touches the reviewed text; they are the lane seat's.
- SQL push-down: no code, no query, no id materialisation. Nothing to find.
- Escalated to the seat, because the answer may be the maintainer's and A4 must not decide past objectstack#37788: the two questions under S1 and S2 below (what closes the drawer's other `ask` doors on the page; what "home" means on a phone and under a declared `landing`).

### ④ Design judgment

File judged: `ui/docs/adr/0057-console-ai-chat-one-conversation-docked.md`, against the card's items 1 to 6, objectstack#37788 items 1 to 8 (its first consumer and execution plan), the rest of ADR-0057, and the code it describes on `main`.

What holds, checked sentence by sentence:

- The three rulings are byte-identical to objectstack#37788's "Filing gate" line, each on its own blockquote line, with the times 02:41Z, 02:51Z, 03:16Z and where they are recorded.
- "A2's key decision: the drawer's `ask` scope is still the product alone" matches A2's Key bullet. `app:PKG:ask` fits §1's `(user, app, product)` key and A2's `app:PKG:build` spelling.
- The Thread bullet's last sentence correctly keeps A3's "What the drawer shows is kept per tab, never in the URL".
- The A3 pointer and the header entry say the same thing as the section. Nothing decides T5 / T6; the Consequences say so.
- Against #37798 as shipped on `main` (`packages/spec/src/ui/ai-chat-nav-params.zod.ts`, `app.zod.ts`, `ui/packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx`): no A4 sentence is made false. "a `type: 'component'` entry whose `componentRef` is `ai:chat`" is `AI_CHAT_COMPONENT_REF` on a component entry. "welcome title and subtitle, composer placeholder, suggested questions" are exactly the four keys `title`, `subtitle`, `placeholder`, `suggestions`; there is no `agent` and no `scope`, which agrees with "The page runs `ask`". "never from the URL" agrees with `resolveHref`, which returns `/component/ai/chat` with no querystring for this ref. "falls back to neutral platform copy" agrees with all four keys being optional with no schema default (the schema sets none; the fallback is the page's). "An app may place one" agrees with `checkAppSingleAiChatEntry` (at most one across `navigation` and every `areas[].navigation`, any depth). A4 names no length limit and no door, so it copies nothing that can drift.

Findings. No must-fix. Two should-fix, each owing a delta review.

S1 (should-fix) — the "never two `ask` conversations" claim is stronger than hiding the robot delivers. A4 says the robot "is hidden, so one screen never draws two `ask` conversations", and the Consequences repeat it. On `main` the robot is one of several doors to the drawer, and the others stay open on that page: (a) the keyboard toggle, which A3's Entry bullet says "stays" (`useConsoleChatDock.tsx`, Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+I, bound whenever the dock is enabled, independent of the button); (b) a drawer already open when the reader clicks the menu entry: its expanded state is kept per tab and survives navigation, so a member arrives on the page with an `ask` drawer beside the page's `ask` conversation and no robot to explain it; (c) an `/ai…` address, which A4 says "still open the drawer", opens it "over the declared landing", which is this page when the app is the default and the page is its home. For a non-maker every one of these is a second `ask` conversation on the screen. Fix in the text: state the rule as the invariant and name the doors, for example that on this page the drawer's `ask` is not drawn (an open one closes on arrival, the keyboard toggle does not open it there) and only a build hand-off opens the drawer; or, if the ruling is read as the robot alone, drop "never" and say what remains. objectstack#37788 item 7 already says "the top-right robot / drawer trigger", so naming the toggle is inside it; (b) and (c) need the seat's answer first.

S2 (should-fix) — the Home bullet is false in two cases the live tree supports. "Placed first in the app's navigation, the page is the app's home" is unconditional. On `main` (`AppContent.tsx`, `resolveLandingRoute` and the app root): a declared `AppSchema.landing` comes first, so a first-placed page is not the home when `landing` names another entry (and a page placed third is the home when `landing` names it); and below 768 px the app root is the app's whole menu (`PhoneAppHome`, objectstack#35881), so on a phone the page is one row of the home, not the home. objectstack#37788 changes neither. What does hold: with no declared `landing`, from 768 px up, the first entry the member is shown lands, and a `component` entry qualifies (objectui#12113). Fix: tie the sentence to the app's existing landing rule instead of to position alone, and say what a phone does, or record that the maintainer wants the phone root to open the page (「做首页」 can be read that way; that is a ruling for the seat to fetch, not for A4 to assume).

Nits.

- N1 (nit) — the spec symbol. Asked explicitly: now that #37798 has merged (05:59:31Z, after this head was written at about 05:31Z), should A4 name `AiChatNavParamsSchema`? Grade: nit. The dev followed the card to the letter (name the symbol only if merged at writing time); "(objectstack#37787)" is still true and resolves, through the closed card and its PR, to the symbol; no sentence is false or incomplete without it, so it has no effect on correctness or the contract. It is still the better text, and the card's conditional shows that was the intent. Since S1 and S2 move the head anyway, fold it into that commit: "that entry's declared `params` (`AiChatNavParamsSchema` in `@objectstack/spec/ui`, objectstack#37787)". Name the symbol and the package only; do not copy keys' limits or the list of doors into the ADR.
- N2 (nit) — "a key the entry does not declare falls back to neutral platform copy" can be misread as an unknown key being tolerated; the shipped schema is closed and refuses one at `navigation.i.params.KEY`. "a key the entry omits" removes the reading.
- N3 (nit) — "One page per app": the shipped check does not count an `ai:chat` entry that a package's navigation contribution adds after parse (stated in `checkAppSingleAiChatEntry`'s own comment). A4 does not claim enforcement, so nothing is false; the page PR should say which entry it reads if two arrive.
- N4 (nit) — Consequences: "the one place in the console shell, outside the drawer, where an assistant conversation is drawn" sits beside A3's three surfaces that keep their own chrome (Studio's copilot, the share page, the runtime bubble). "the one app page" would be exact.
- N5 (nit, PR body, the seat's) — the body still says #37798 "is still open at this head"; it merged at 05:59Z.

The PR body still says #37798 is open (N5); that goes forward at the hand-off.

**Delta.** The original reviewer reads the new head for S1 and S2. I then do the L1 delta.

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：给 ADR-0057 加修订 A4，记下「做首页，本页隐藏机器人」这条裁定：一个应用可以在菜单里放一个通用的「AI 问询」页面；在这一页上右侧对话抽屉关闭、右上角机器人和快捷键都不打开抽屉，其余页面照旧。这一页排在菜单第一位就是首页。
- 风险：只加 90 行决策文字，不改代码；首页 #37788 的实现以它为依据。手机上应用是否直接打开这一页，文中标为未决，不在本次范围。
- 要你做什么：审批人批准即可，契约审核 PASS 评论 7211638815，Head-sha `2818352d6ce1ac43ccbad25dff097bcd059ceeb0`；批准后座位自主落地，随后派发首页 #37788。
- 不批会怎样：ADR-0057 仍写着「没有 AI 页面」，首页 #37788 无法照决策记录开工。

Seat opinion: land.
